templates.master: Character model sheet of ONE fictional person: {look} Full body, standing, front view, arms relaxed at the sides. Background is a perfectly plain flat mid-grey with nothing on it: no wall texture, no floor line, no lamp, no cast shadow. Even soft front light, whole figure visible with margin on all sides.
templates.pose: The same person from the reference image, identical face, hair, glasses, body and identical clothes and colours. Now {pose}. Keep exactly the same illustration style, ink outlines and colours. Plain flat mid-grey background, no floor, no cast shadow, no lamp, no props except those named, full body visible with margin.
templates.set: Lit by {light}. {base} Open clear floor area in the foreground.
templates.compose: Image 1 is the scene. Paint into it {acts}. Keep image 1's room, camera, composition, colours, grain and illustration style exactly. Each person keeps the identical face, hair, glasses, clothes and colours from their reference image, at realistic scale for the room, lit by the scene's own light with matching shadows on the floor. No extra people, no text.

tailor_shop.base: Wide interior of a small neighbourhood tailoring shop seen from inside: wooden front counter with one sewing machine under a hanging lamp, a dress form wearing a half-finished white wedding dress, rolls of fabric on shelves, a small old TV on a shelf, a large shop window onto a quiet street with one street lamp.

kitchen.base: Small modest family kitchen: a round wooden table with two chairs, an open laptop, a mug, a stack of plain envelopes, a fridge, a window over the sink showing rooftops.

event_stage.base: Hotel ballroom event stage seen from the audience: a lectern, a huge blank glowing projection screen, gold uplights, haze, a heavy dark curtain, the edge of the stage; the audience area is empty rows of chairs.

dev_flat.base: Cluttered one-room flat of a software developer: a desk with three blank monitors, stacks of books, a whiteboard with only scribbled lines, a desk lamp, a window.

airport_hall.base: Wide shot of an empty airport departure hall: huge windows onto a runway, rows of empty seats, a large blank departure board panel, polished reflective floor, one lonely rolling suitcase.

courthouse.base: Exterior of a grand stone courthouse: wide steps, tall columns, heavy doors, no flags, no seals, no carvings with words.
